kebab_example: aliyun winnexo get-todo --app-token wn_app_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --ops-user-id 10001 --ops-user-code alice --tenant-id 10000 --todo-id todo_abc123 --work-item-id wi_1 --message-id msg-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTodo

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is executed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The to-do item ID. Used for get operations
parameters.name: todo_id

parameters.help_en: The work item ID. Used to query multiple to-do items by source
parameters.help_zh: 工作项ID（按来源反查多条）
parameters.name: work_item_id

parameters.help_en: The assistant message ID. Used to query multiple to-do items by message
parameters.help_zh: assistant 消息ID（按消息反查多条）
parameters.name: message_id

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

todo.description_en: The single result returned when querying by todoId. This field is empty for other query types. The field set is the same as the flattened structure of getTodoDetail
todo.description_zh: todoId 查询时的单条结果（其余查询为空）；字段集同 getTodoDetail 平铺结构

todos.description_en: The multiple results returned when querying by workItemId or messageId. This field is empty when querying by todoId
todos.description_zh: workItemId/messageId 查询时的多条结果（todoId 查询为空）

items.description_en: The multiple results returned when querying by workItemId or messageId. This field is empty when querying by todoId
items.description_zh: workItemId/messageId 查询时的多条结果（todoId 查询为空）
items.example: {"todoId":"todo_abc123","status":"PENDING","priority":"MEDIUM","title":"治理审批","summary":"待办事项摘要","questions":{"是否通过审批":"通过"},"sourceContext":{"source":"openapi"},"resultPayload":{"answers":[{"question":"是否通过审批","answer":["通过"]}]},"completedByUserId":"42","completedAt":"2026-10-12 10:00:00","assignees":[{"assigneeUserId":"42","assigneeSource":"ORIGINAL","status":"PENDING","readAt":"2026-10-12 10:01:00","actedAt":"2026-10-16T10:30:00+08:00"}],"messageId":"msg-1","gmtCreate":"2026-10-12 10:00:00","gmtModified":"2026-10-12 10:00:00"}

actedAt.description_en: The action time in UTC+8. This field is empty if no action is taken
actedAt.description_zh: 处理时间（北京时间）；未处理为空

assigneeSource.description_en: The source of the assignee. Valid values: ORIGINAL, TRANSFERRED

assigneeUserId.description_en: The user ID of the assignee

readAt.description_en: The read time in UTC+8. This field is empty if the item is unread
readAt.description_zh: 已读时间（北京时间）；未读为空

status.description_en: The action status of the assignee

transferredFromUserId.description_en: The user ID of the transferor. This field is populated only when the to-do item is transferred
transferredFromUserId.description_zh: 转出人用户ID；仅转办产生

completedByUserId.description_en: The user ID of the person who completed the to-do item

gmtModified.description_en: The last modification time in UTC+8
gmtModified.description_zh: 最后修改时间（北京时间）

messageId.description_en: The assistant message ID. This field is empty if there is no conversation source
messageId.description_zh: assistant 消息ID；无会话来源为空

questions.description_en: The question list in raw JSONB format

resultPayload.description_en: The answer payload in raw JSONB format

sourceContext.description_en: The source context passed through as-is

status.description_en: The primary status of the to-do item

summary.description_en: The summary of the to-do item

title.description_en: The title of the to-do item
